Name: Alchemistry
Author: BitSmith
TagLine: Grow mystical crops, brew potions, and transform your farm!
Description:
📖 About the Mod

Alchemistry expands the world of Stardew Valley with elements of magic and alchemy.
Instead of focusing only on farming, you’ll discover new ways to play, combining agriculture, gathering, and potion-making with mystical progression.

Expect:

New crops, some magical, some poisonous.

Collectible herbs, berries, and flowers throughout the valley.

New fish and reasons to build ponds.

Magical gems and ectoplasm for alchemical crafting.

Monster loot with unique uses.

Deeper friendship with the Wizard, who becomes your mentor.

Lore changes about your grandfather’s past.

A mysterious new NPC and a new area to explore.

Alchemy machines for processing resources.

Craftable potions, explosive brews, and tweaks to base game items.

🛠 Installation
Option 1 — Manual install

Make sure you have SMAPI installed.

Download the latest version of the mod.

Extract the archive into your Mods folder:

%APPDATA%\StardewValley\Mods\


Launch the game through SMAPI.

Option 2 — Automatic installer

We’ve included a Windows installer (.bat) for your convenience:

Double-click InstallAlchemistry.bat.

It will automatically download, extract, and place the files in the correct Mods folder.

Recommended if you don’t want to deal with manual extraction.

🎮 Gameplay Notes

Some crops and items are toxic – read carefully before using them.

The Wizard will guide your alchemy journey; progress requires friendship.

Potions are crafted through new alchemical machines.

A mysterious storyline will unfold as you explore.

🔄 Compatibility

Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6+.

Requires SMAPI.

Other content mods may or may not conflict if they change Wizard events or Grandpa’s lore.

📬 Feedback

If you find bugs or have suggestions, please post them in the Posts or Bugs section of this mod page.

Enjoy your magical journey through Stardew Valley! ✨

⚠️ About the Installer (.bat)

This mod includes an optional automatic installer (InstallAlchemistry.bat) for Windows 10/11 users.

What it does:

Copies the mod files into your %APPDATA%\StardewValley\Mods\ folder.

Makes installation easier if you don’t want to extract and move files manually.

Why it might be flagged:

Nexus Mods automated scans and some antivirus software mark .bat files as suspicious by default.

This is expected behavior, because batch scripts can contain unsafe commands.

Our installer is safe and only automates file placement.

If you prefer:

You can always install manually by extracting the mod folder into:

%APPDATA%\StardewValley\Mods\


The .bat file is optional.
